# Marketing Studio: Your Imagination Engine

> A creative studio for creators who want control over the finished story.

Marketing Studio is an integrated generative video and audio platform that lets creators turn any topic or script into an edited documentary video with scene-by-scene control.

## Core Workflows

- **Documentary Desk (/projects)**: Write a topic or edit a drafted script. Review alternative video options per scene, bring choices into an editable multi-track timeline, and mix narration and soundtrack.
- **Avatar Studio (/avatar)**: Generate and save reusable character identities across image, video, and scene-based storytelling.
- **Audio Studio (/audio)**: Generate speech, dialogue, voice cloning, and audio effects in an integrated audio suite.
- **Video & Image Templates (/video-templates, /images-templates, /effects)**: Recreate camera moves, lighting, and scene setups while maintaining subject continuity.
- **Model Context Protocol (/mcp)**: Built-in local and remote MCP server enabling AI coding assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf) to draft scripts, query stock footage, and manage projects.

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Single Page Application built on React 19, TypeScript, and Vite, served at `https://www.marketingstudioie.site`.
- **Backend API**: Node.js & Express API with async job execution, served at `https://api.marketingstudioie.site`.
- **Database & Storage**: Multi-user tenancy with Supabase Postgres and Cloudflare R2 for zero-egress presigned media storage.
- **Compute Runners**: Serverless GPU (RunPod) for image and edit models, serverless CPU for video timeline stitching and audio processing, and Modal H200 for accelerated generative video.

## Pricing & Usage

- **Free**: 1 avatar, 5 images, 3 videos, 10 documentaries, and 300 audio credits per month. No credit card required.
- **Pro**: 30 avatars, 100 images, 30 videos, 200 documentaries, and 5,000 audio credits per month.
- **Premium**: 300 avatars, 1,000 images, 300 videos, 2,000 documentaries, and 50,000 audio credits per month.
- **Contact & Support**: Phone support available at `+92-300-4084760`.
